summary.text: DeAndrea Salvador is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 39 since January 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a nonprofit executive who founded the Renewable Energy Transition Initiative.

paragraphs.text: DeAndrea Salvador graduated from Waddell High School and earned a degree in economics from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career includes founding and serving as executive director of the Renewable Energy Transition Initiative (RETI), and she serves on the boards of Clean Air Carolina and Youth Empowered Solutions.
Salvador assumed office in the Senate on January 1, 2021, succeeding Rob Bryan.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural and Economic Resources; Commerce and Insurance; Finance; Transportation; and Rules and Operations of the Senate.
